tags.reason: Published only on the private incubation repository, which was deleted after the public consolidation onto Generous-Corp/vellum. The tag object, release, attestation, and assets no longer exist. Re-creating the name would give a second immutable v0.1.7 with different bytes, so the name is never reused. The target commit remains in this repository's history.

Tagged and frozen by release-tag.yml on the commit that landed the v0.1.9 release request (#137's merge), but never published: its provenance run (41368275724) failed the reconciled observatory tail check, because a commit that lands a release request can never name itself as the observatory cursor, and every input to a re-run is fixed by the frozen tag. The tag stays in place and frozen; no release is published from it, and the name is never reused. The same content ships as v0.1.10 from an observatory-reconciled commit (owner decision 2026-11-02).
